FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: MA20 Support Preserves Tactical Upside Despite USD Political Risk
tldr_points: Price at 158.53 remains above MA20 at 157.97, preserving a tactical bullish structure.
RSI-14 at 68.54 is near overbought, making a pullback entry preferable to chasing.
Oil and risk appetite support the cross, while record-low Trump approval limits conviction to medium.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY retains a tactical upside bias above MA20, but stretched momentum and USD political risk favor buying dips.
FX.comment: A MA20-retest long offers favorable tactical asymmetry while 157.97 support holds, despite near-overbought momentum and mixed US political signals.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] FLAT: Price Below MA20 Amid Mixed Tech/Yield Dynamics
tldr_points: Price trading below MA20 suggests near-term resistance.

STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 trades below MA20 as tech gains counter yield pressure, pointing to a neutral, range-bound stance.
STOCKS.comment: Price below MA20 with neutral RSI suggests a range-bound stance awaiting clearer catalyst.
